name: Sociological Theory
description: This is an advanced level seminar course, which aims to understand the theoretical principles that have continued to influence the discipline in last two hundred years. The course will discuss the work of the founding fathers (i.e. Karl Marx, Max Weber, and Emile Durkheim) and examine the relevance of their work in the contemporary socio-historical context. It will discuss the complex and interrelated social, cultural, economic and political issues and explore the way classical theorists have dealt with them. Specifically, it will understand how these issues affect our understanding of the world and our everyday lived experience. The central focus of this course will be the understanding of the main structures, processes and contradictions of the modern, capitalist society and the way classical sociologists have explained and interpreted it.
